name: ION: Dusha Kur'era
source: This mod is inspired by the Story of a Loser (ION) and tells the story of a guy named Semyon, who, because of his problems, was forced to go to work in delivery. But how significant are these problems in the global plan, what lies in his soul and what events and acquaintances await him on his way? You will find out about all this in our mod!
